h1: The unlimited-wash membership that logs your plate every visit

criteria.h1: The unlimited-wash membership that logs your plate every visit
tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for service businesses (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. A Friday express-wash slot or an unlimited-wash membership package is a booking you create; a service name such as car wash or plate membership is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Plate, membership-ID, visit-timestamp, or location questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, input, or checkbox); they are not documented defaults. A booking is a calendar row, not proof anyone washed a car — and a CSV export of a Friday 3pm express slot next to a plate answer and a home address is still a calendar that holds a visit ledger beside a contact name. Emails can include those custom fields and copy the appointment off-site. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional. Public booking-form browser hosts are unverified. | Wash-membership bookings stored on your WordPress site | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv4.0.3 readme.txt (SVN)

Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form BuilderDocumented self-hosted form builder (plugin version 1.58.1). The listing states Forminator stores and organizes submissions so you can sort, analyze, and manage responses, and includes a free file-upload field with multi-file support. Version 1.58.1 helper-fields.php forminator_upload_root() writes under the WordPress uploads directory plus /forminator/, with per-form hashed subfolders from forminator_get_upload_path(). upload.php stores files through that path. Plate, membership-ID, visit-timestamp, location, or home-address fields are fields you add; they are not documented defaults. Completing the form can store a plate answer next to a visit timestamp, a location label, a membership ID, a home address, and optional intake uploads — typed once as the unlimited-wash membership that logs your plate every visit, into the same tables as a monthly wash bill. A plate answer is what a member typed or a gate system wrote, not a DMV record. A membership booking is a calendar row, not proof anyone washed a car — and a staff login can open "Alex, plate ABC1234, North site, Friday 3pm, license.pdf" next to everyone else's resume. Notification emails can copy field values and files off-site. Optional Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Mailchimp, and webhook integrations send data only when you enable them. Public form-page browser hosts are unverified. | Car-wash membership and plate-intake answers stored in WordPress; optional intake uploads in the site uploads/forminator folder | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv1.58.1 readme.txt (SVN)v1.58.1 helper-fields.php (upload root)v1.58.1 upload.php
